Introduction

JMIN, born Jonathan Min, is a Korean-American rapper who debuted independently in 2018. He joined Jay Park & Cha Cha Malone's H1GHR MUSIC in 2021. He made his official debut under H1GHR Music with his first ep “HOMECOMING” which dropped on August 13, 2021.
